usage: 出 is commonly used as a verb meaning 'to go out' or 'to come out'.
It often appears in common patterns like 出街 (go out to town), 出去 (go out), or 出門口 (go out the door).
It can be used in both formal and informal contexts.
出 can also combine with other words to express direction, movement, or leaving a place.
